relationships.title: Master of Blades
relationships.description: The Warrior wields the Sword with unmatched skill, trained through years of combat to strike with precision and power.

relationships.title: Arcane Knowledge
relationships.description: The Mage casts powerful spells from the Spell Book, channeling ancient magical knowledge into devastating effects.

relationships.title: Silent Strike
relationships.description: The Rogue wields twin Daggers with deadly precision, striking from the shadows before enemies know they're there.

relationships.title: Stalwart Defense
relationships.description: The Warrior defends with a Shield, forming an impenetrable barrier that protects allies and absorbs enemy attacks.

relationships.title: Arcane Focus
relationships.description: The Mage channels magical energy through the Staff, amplifying spell power and reducing the cost of casting.

relationships.title: Battle Recovery
relationships.description: Potions heal the Warrior's wounds in the heat of battle, restoring health and stamina to continue fighting.

relationships.title: Dragon's Hoard
relationships.description: The Dragon guards its Treasure jealously, sleeping atop mountains of gold and magical artifacts collected over centuries.

relationships.title: Magical Weapon
relationships.description: The Sword is enhanced by Enchantment, glowing with magical energy that increases damage and grants special abilities.

relationships.title: Knight's Training
relationships.description: The Castle trains Warriors in its barracks, producing skilled knights who defend the realm from threats.

relationships.title: Hidden Riches
relationships.description: The Dungeon hides Treasure in its deepest chambers, protected by traps, monsters, and ancient curses.

relationships.title: Dungeon Delver
relationships.description: The Rogue explores Dungeons with stealth and cunning, disarming traps and finding secret passages others miss.

relationships.title: Arcane Crafting
relationships.description: The Mage creates Enchantments through ritual magic, imbuing items with permanent magical properties.

relationships.title: Heavy Armor
relationships.description: Armor protects the Warrior from physical attacks, allowing them to stand on the front lines and absorb damage.

relationships.title: Magical Formulas
relationships.description: The Spell Book contains Enchantment formulas, teaching mages how to permanently bind magic to physical objects.

relationships.title: Dragon Siege
relationships.description: The Dragon threatens the Castle with fire and fury, demanding tribute or facing the destruction of the kingdom.

relationships.title: Alchemical Art
relationships.description: Potions are brewed by Mages using alchemical knowledge, combining magical ingredients to create powerful elixirs.

relationships.title: Poisoned Blade
relationships.description: The Dagger is enhanced by Enchantment with poison or shadow magic, making each strike more lethal.

relationships.title: Dragon Slayer
relationships.description: The Warrior battles the Dragon in epic combat, using strength and courage to overcome the legendary beast.

relationships.title: Arcane Power
relationships.description: The Staff is infused with Enchantment, becoming a legendary artifact that amplifies the wielder's magical abilities.

relationships.title: Master Thief
relationships.description: The Rogue steals Treasure with unmatched skill, slipping past guards and traps to claim the most valuable prizes.
